observations: Actually opened full July2017 photo: no23 porch pillar and historic St Nicholas school fascia identify the target left of24. School use today is not established.

Three bays and five tiers; short fifth tier has narrow sashes; plain outer piers rather than24 pronounced corner quoins, stepped simple cornice, ground channelling, Ionic right-bay porch and Corinthian first-floor order/center pediment, stone balustrade, upper Juliet bars. Roof/rear unseen; parked cars obscure ground.
